classData.comment:
/**
 * A singleton utility class responsible for recursively building VDOM and VNode trees.
 * It can expand component references within a tree structure into their full VDOM/VNode representations,
 * supporting selective (asymmetric) tree expansion for optimized updates.
 * @class Neo.util.vdom.TreeBuilder
 * @extends Neo.core.Base
 * @singleton
 */
classData.description: A singleton utility class responsible for recursively building VDOM and VNode trees. It can expand component references within a tree structure into their full VDOM/VNode representations, supporting selective (asymmetric) tree expansion for optimized updates.
classData.name: TreeBuilder

classData.comment:
/**
     * The length of the longest chain of nested components rooted at the given component, counting the
     * component itself as 1. A component with no child components is 1; one whose vdom references a
     * child which itself references another is 3.
     *
     * This is the inverse of the pruning `#buildTree` performs, and lives beside it so the two read the
     * same structure: a caller that needs a tree fully expanded down to `component` can pass
     * `distanceToComponent + getComponentDepth(component)` as its depth instead of a literal, which
     * would silently become a snapshot of whatever nesting happened to ship.
     *
     * @param {Neo.component.Base} component
     * @returns {Number}
     */
classData.description:
The length of the longest chain of nested components rooted at the given component, counting the component itself as 1. A component with no child components is 1; one whose vdom references a child which itself references another is 3.

This is the inverse of the pruning #buildTree performs, and lives beside it so the two read the same structure: a caller that needs a tree fully expanded down to component can pass distanceToComponent + getComponentDepth(component) as its depth instead of a literal, which would silently become a snapshot of whatever nesting happened to ship.
classData.name: getComponentDepth

     */
